tools.name: Cursor
tools.oneLiner: AI-native IDE that speeds up shipping and refactoring.

whyTemplates.developer: You ship code daily — an AI IDE cuts iteration loops without changing your stack.
whyTemplates.default: High ROI for technical freelancers who bill by deliverable.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.oneLiner: Inline code suggestions across your editor and GitHub.

whyTemplates.developer: Autocomplete across repos saves hours on boilerplate and tests each week.
whyTemplates.default: Strong fit for developers who want low-friction AI in existing workflows.

tools.name: v0 by Vercel
tools.oneLiner: Generate UI components and prototypes from prompts.

whyTemplates.developer: Ship client-facing UI faster — generate components you can refine instead of starting from scratch.
whyTemplates.designer: Bridge design and dev: turn mockup ideas into working React prototypes for client review.
whyTemplates.default: Accelerates frontend delivery for freelancers juggling design and code.

tools.name: Replit Agent
tools.oneLiner: Autonomous coding agent that builds and deploys small apps.

whyTemplates.developer: Great for quick client MVPs — spin up and deploy prototypes without managing infra.
whyTemplates.default: Useful when you need to demo ideas fast for non-technical clients.

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.oneLiner: AI writing assistant for grammar, tone, and clarity.

whyTemplates.writer: Catches errors and tone mismatches before client delivery — fewer revision rounds.
whyTemplates.marketer: Keeps campaign copy polished across channels without a separate editor pass.
whyTemplates.default: Baseline quality control for any client-facing writing.

tools.name: Jasper
tools.oneLiner: Brand-aware AI copywriting for marketing and content teams.

whyTemplates.writer: Scale long-form and campaign copy while keeping a consistent brand voice per client.
whyTemplates.marketer: Draft ad variants and landing copy faster — you refine strategy, not first drafts.
whyTemplates.default: Best when you manage multiple client voices and need volume.

tools.name: Surfer SEO
tools.oneLiner: Data-driven content optimization for search rankings.

whyTemplates.writer: SEO clients expect data-backed briefs — Surfer turns guesswork into defensible outlines.
whyTemplates.marketer: Rank content faster with SERP-aware recommendations clients can see in reports.
whyTemplates.default: High ROI if SEO is part of your service offering.

tools.name: Copy.ai
tools.oneLiner: Templates and workflows for marketing copy at speed.

whyTemplates.marketer: Batch social and email variants in one sitting — strong for retainer clients.
whyTemplates.writer: Good for short-form bursts when you're juggling multiple deliverables.
whyTemplates.default: Solid starter for freelancers who need volume without Jasper's price tag.

tools.name: Notion AI
tools.oneLiner: AI writing and summarization inside your Notion workspace.

whyTemplates.writer: Summarize research and client calls into briefs without leaving your notes.
whyTemplates.pm: Turn meeting notes into action items and status updates in one place.
whyTemplates.default: High ROI if Notion is already your client hub.

tools.name: Figma AI
tools.oneLiner: AI-assisted design tools inside Figma for faster iteration.

whyTemplates.designer: Generate layout variants and rename layers — spend time on craft, not grunt work.
whyTemplates.default: Essential if Figma is your primary delivery tool.

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.oneLiner: Generative image creation for concepts and campaign visuals.

whyTemplates.designer: Rapid concept exploration before committing to final assets — clients love seeing options fast.
whyTemplates.marketer: Produce campaign visuals and mood boards without a full photo shoot budget.
whyTemplates.default: High ROI for visual freelancers who sell concepts, not just polish.

tools.name: Canva Magic Studio
tools.oneLiner: AI design tools for social, decks, and quick client deliverables.

whyTemplates.marketer: Batch social assets for clients who need speed over bespoke craft.
whyTemplates.designer: Hand off templated deliverables faster while you focus on premium work.
whyTemplates.default: Great when clients want fast turnaround on standard formats.

tools.name: Adobe Firefly
tools.oneLiner: Commercial-safe generative AI integrated with Creative Cloud.

whyTemplates.designer: Generative fill and text effects in Photoshop — commercial-safe for client work.
whyTemplates.default: Best if you're already in the Adobe ecosystem.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.oneLiner: AI search with cited sources for fast, verifiable research.

whyTemplates.researcher: Cited answers cut hours of tab-hopping — clients trust sourced summaries.
whyTemplates.writer: Background research for articles and whitepapers with links you can footnote.
whyTemplates.marketer: Competitive and market research with sources for strategy decks.
whyTemplates.default: Replaces scattered Googling with one research pass.

tools.name: Elicit
tools.oneLiner: AI research assistant for academic and technical literature.

whyTemplates.researcher: Systematic lit reviews in hours, not days — essential for evidence-based deliverables.
whyTemplates.writer: Back technical and thought-leadership pieces with real paper summaries.
whyTemplates.default: High ROI for research-heavy freelance niches.

tools.name: Consensus
tools.oneLiner: Search engine over scientific papers with consensus summaries.

whyTemplates.researcher: Quickly answer 'what does the research say?' for client reports.
whyTemplates.writer: Add credibility to health, science, or policy content with paper-backed claims.
whyTemplates.default: Strong when clients need evidence, not opinions.

tools.name: Linear
tools.oneLiner: Fast issue tracking and project management for product teams.

whyTemplates.developer: Share progress with technical clients in a tool that feels native to dev workflows.
whyTemplates.pm: Lightweight PM that doesn't slow you down — clients see status without Slack chaos.
whyTemplates.default: Professional project visibility without enterprise CRM overhead.

tools.name: HubSpot AI
tools.oneLiner: CRM with AI for content, email, and pipeline management.

whyTemplates.marketer: Manage client campaigns and pipelines in one place — AI drafts emails and reports.
whyTemplates.pm: Track multiple client relationships without a separate sales stack.
whyTemplates.default: High ROI when you run marketing retainers and need CRM + content.

tools.name: Fireflies.ai
tools.oneLiner: AI meeting transcription with summaries and action items.

whyTemplates.pm: Never miss a client decision — auto-summaries become your project paper trail.
whyTemplates.writer: Turn discovery calls into briefs without manual note-taking.
whyTemplates.marketer: Capture campaign kickoff decisions and sync to your task list.
whyTemplates.default: One of the highest-ROI tools for anyone on client calls weekly.

tools.name: Notion
tools.oneLiner: All-in-one workspace for notes, projects, and client wikis.

whyTemplates.pm: Client portals and project hubs in one link — reduces 'where's that doc?' emails.
whyTemplates.writer: Centralize briefs, drafts, and feedback per client.
whyTemplates.developer: Lightweight specs and handoff docs clients can actually read.
